task_contract.goal: Reject duplicate inventory SKUs after canonical normalization.
exclusions: Do not special-case only an identical raw spelling.
acceptance_conditions: Whitespace/case-equivalent duplicate SKUs are also rejected.

evidence.claim: The loop overwrites dictionary entries when a duplicate key is seen.
The shadow case differs in raw spelling but has the same canonical SKU.

localization.failure_or_requirement: Duplicate SKUs must not silently overwrite earlier quantities.
localization.why_this_location: This loop performs the overwriting assignment.
localization.why_not_obvious_alternatives: The defect is local to duplicate handling in aggregation.

hypotheses.statement: Rejecting only repeated raw SKU strings is sufficient to satisfy duplicate protection.
hypotheses.falsifier: If differently spelled inputs normalize to the same canonical SKU and remain accepted, this hypothesis is false.
hypotheses.expected_observation_if_true: Both exact and normalization-equivalent duplicate tests pass.

items.expected_effect: Reject repeated raw SKU strings before assignment.
items.risk: Normalization-equivalent spellings may still bypass the check.
